prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1036
Claimant:
James Burton
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
6-23-25
Claimant reported a sideswipe while changing lanes and said the impact came from the right rear quarter of their
vehicle. They described feeling dazed and were later diagonsed with a concussion at an urgent care clinic.
7-4-25
Reviewed the first photos from the scene. They show damage along the driver's side that is largely consistent with the
impact the claimant described.
7-11-25
Spoke with the claimant by phone to take a full statement. The account matched the initial report in every detail,
including the lane, the speed, and the sequence of events.
7-23-25
Confirmed with the responding police report that the claimant was present in the vehicle at the time. The officer's
notes also match the location and direction of travel described.
9-16-25
Requested the medical records from the treating clinic. The injury described fits the kind and force of a side impact of
this type.
11-14-25
No independent witnesses have come forward, so the case rests on the physical evidence and the parties' accounts.
The photos confirm some of the details the claimant gave.
12-24-25
Checked prior claims and vehicle history. No earlier damage to this vehicle is on record, and nothing suggests the
damage predates the policy's coverage start.
12-29-25
Reviewed the treatment notes. Care followed a typical course and eased off steadily as the claimant's symptoms
improved. No earlier injury to the same area of the head or neck appears in the records.
1-16-26
Confirmed the driver is listed as a named insured on the policy. Spoke with the claimant again, who repeated the
same account without changes.
1-17-26
Repair estimate is largely in line with the described impact. Based on the evidence gathered so far, the claim is
proceeding to the next review stage for a settlement decision.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
